license_required.quote: A person must be certified or registered in order to engage in the business of contracting in this state.

issuing_authority.quote: there is created within the department the Construction Industry Licensing Board

name.quote: there is created within the department the Construction Industry Licensing Board

type.quote: The board shall consist of 18 members, of whom: (a) Four are primarily engaged in business as general contractors; (b) Three are primarily engaged in business as building contractors or residential contractors

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Business and Professional Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: there is created within the department the Construction Industry Licensing Board

degree_required.value: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited 4-year college in the appropriate field of engineering, architecture, or building construction and has 1 year of proven experience in the category in which the person seeks to qualify.
degree_required.quote: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited 4-year college in the appropriate field of engineering, architecture, or building construction and has 1 year of proven experience in the category in which the person seeks to qualify.

credential_pegged.quote: Has received a baccalaureate degree from an accredited 4-year college in the appropriate field of engineering, architecture, or building construction and has 1 year of proven experience

required.quote: Has a total of at least 4 years of active experience as a worker who has learned the trade by serving an apprenticeship as a skilled worker who is able to command the rate of a mechanic in the particular trade or as a foreman

experience_source.quote: Has a total of at least 4 years of active experience as a worker who has learned the trade by serving an apprenticeship as a skilled worker

duration.quote: Has a total of at least 4 years of active experience as a worker who has learned the trade by serving an apprenticeship as a skilled worker

exams.name: Contractor's examination (category-specific)
exams.notes: Applicant with baccalaureate degree in building construction from accredited 4-year college with GPA 3.0 or higher need only take and pass the business and finance portion.
exams.quote: Any person who desires to engage in contracting on a statewide basis shall, as a prerequisite thereto, establish his or her competency and qualifications to be certified pursuant to this part. To establish competency, a person shall pass the appropriate examination approved by the board and certified by the department.

interval_years.quote: Each certificateholder or registrant who desires to continue as a certificateholder or registrant shall renew the certificate or registration every 2 years.

required.quote: Each certificateholder or registrant shall provide proof, in a form established by rule of the board, that the certificateholder or registrant has completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium since the issuance or renewal of the certificate or registration.

hours_per_period.quote: completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

period_years.quote: completed at least 14 classroom hours of at least 50 minutes each of continuing education courses during each biennium

topical_requirements.quote: The board shall establish by rule that a portion of the required 14 hours must deal with the subject of workers' compensation, business practices, workplace safety, and, for applicable licensure categories, wind mitigation methodologies, and 1 hour of which must deal with laws and rules.

available.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for certification by endorsement any applicant who: (a) Meets the requirements for certification as set forth in this section; has passed a national, regional, state, or United States territorial licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination required by this part

requirements.value: Applicant must meet one of: (a) passed a substantially equivalent exam and met § 489.111 requirements; (b) holds a valid license from another state/territory with substantially equivalent criteria; (c) holds a valid license under a reciprocal agreement; or (d) held a valid license for at least 10 years before application. Division I contractors and roofing contractors must complete a 2-hour Florida Building Code course.
requirements.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for certification by endorsement any applicant who: (a) Meets the requirements for certification as set forth in this section; has passed a national, regional, state, or United States territorial licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination required by this part; and has satisfied the requirements set forth in s. 489.111; (b) Holds a valid license to practice contracting issued by another state or territory of the United States, if the criteria for issuance of such license were substantially equivalent to Florida's current certification criteria

exists.quote: there is created within the department the Construction Industry Licensing Board

regulatory_model.quote: A person must be certified or registered in order to engage in the business of contracting in this state.

credential_type.quote: No person may engage in the business of contracting in this state without first being certified or registered in the proper classification.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may engage in the business of contracting in this state without first being certified or registered in the proper classification.

title_protection.quote: No person shall: (a) Falsely hold himself or herself or a business organization out as a licensee, certificateholder, or registrant

scope_protection.quote: No person may engage in the business of contracting in this state without first being certified or registered in the proper classification.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate or registration by fraud or misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a certificate or registration by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, a crime directly relating to the practice of contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of contracting or the ability to practice contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in the prohibited uncertified and unregistered practice of contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act which assists a person or entity in engaging in the prohibited uncertified and unregistered practice of contracting, if the certificateholder or registrant knows or has reasonable grounds to know that the person or entity was uncertified and unregistered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an uncertified or unregistered person by allowing his or her certificate or registration to be used by that person with intent to evade the provisions of this part.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly combining or conspiring with an uncertified or unregistered person by allowing his or her certificate or registration to be used by the uncertified or unregistered person with intent to evade the provisions of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any certificate or registration except in the name of the certificateholder or registrant as set forth on the issued certificate or registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any certificate or registration issued hereunder except in the name of the certificateholder or registrant as set forth on the issued certificate or registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing mismanagement or misconduct in the practice of contracting that causes financial harm to a customer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act or violation of this part.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being disciplined by any municipality or county for an act or violation of this part.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part or violating a rule or lawful order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this part or violating a rule or lawful order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning a construction project in which the contractor is engaged or under contract as a contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning a construction project in which the contractor is engaged or under contract as a contractor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a statement with respect to a project or contract falsely indicating work is bonded, payments made, or insurance provided.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a statement with respect to a project or contract falsely indicating that the work is bonded; falsely indicating that payment has been made for all subcontracted work, labor, and materials which results in a financial loss to the owner, purchaser, or contractor; or falsely indicating that workers' compensation and public liability insurance are provided.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud or deceit in the practice of contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing incompetency or misconduct in the practice of contracting.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing incompetency or misconduct in the practice of contracting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross negligence, repeated negligence, or negligence resulting in a significant danger to life or property.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross negligence, repeated negligence, or negligence resulting in a significant danger to life or property.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Proceeding on any job without obtaining applicable local building department permits and inspections.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intimidating, threatening, coercing, or otherwise discouraging the service of a notice to owner or notice to contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intimidating, threatening, coercing, or otherwise discouraging the service of a notice to owner under part I of chapter 713 or a notice to contractor under chapter 255 or part I of chapter 713.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time the terms of a civil judgment obtained against the licensee relating to the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to satisfy within a reasonable time, the terms of a civil judgment obtained against the licensee, or the business organization qualified by the licensee, relating to the practice of the licensee's profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing misapplication of construction funds in violation of s. 713.345.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing misapplication of construction funds in violation of s. 713.345.

bonding_required.quote: To require one bond for each contractor in an amount not to exceed $5,000, which bond shall be conditioned only upon compliance with the Florida Building Code adopted pursuant to s. 553.73.

insurance_required.quote: the applicant shall submit an affidavit on a form provided by the board attesting to the fact that the applicant has obtained workers' compensation insurance as required by chapter 440, public liability insurance, and property damage insurance for the safety and welfare of the public, in amounts determined by rule of the board.

definition_quote.value: Contractor means the person who is qualified for, and is only responsible for, the project contracted for and means, except as exempted in this part, the person who, for compensation, undertakes to, submits a bid to, or does himself or herself or by others construct, repair, alter, remodel, add to, demolish, subtract from, or improve any building or structure, including related improvements to real estate, for others or for resale to others.
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor" means the person who is qualified for, and is only responsible for, the project contracted for and means, except as exempted in this part, the person who, for compensation, undertakes to, submits a bid to, or does himself or herself or by others construct, repair, alter, remodel, add to, demolish, subtract from, or improve any building or structure, including related improvements to real estate, for others or for resale to others

value: improvement of buildings or structures including related improvements to real estate
methods_authorized.quote: construct, repair, alter, remodel, add to, demolish, subtract from, or improve any building or structure, including related improvements to real estate, for others or for resale to others

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: The registration or certification number of each contractor shall appear in each offer of services, business proposal, bid, contract, or advertisement, regardless of medium, as defined by board rule, used by that contractor or business organization in the practice of contracting.

right_of_rescission_days.quote: A residential property owner may cancel a contract to replace or repair a roof without penalty or obligation within 10 days after the execution of the contract or by the official start date, whichever comes first

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: Any work or operation of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature in which the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than $2,500

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: no county or municipality may require any certificateholder to obtain a local professional license or pay a local professional license fee as a condition of performing any services within the scope of the certificateholder's statewide license as established under this part

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: Each certificateholder or registrant who desires to continue as a certificateholder or registrant shall renew the certificate or registration every 2 years.
